steps.name: Install and verify system dev dependencies and configure persistent Qt environment
steps.description: Idempotently install required system packages (cmake, pkg-config, libglib2.0-dev, libqt6-dev or libqt5-dev if available, Xvfb, x11-utils, ca-certificates, locales, binutils). Validate CMake version (>=3.16) and presence of ctest. Probe installed Qt layout and write /etc/profile.d/qt_env.sh atomically with correct PKG_CONFIG_PATH and QT_PLUGIN_PATH derived from discovered locations. If Qt dev packages are unavailable, fail fast with remediation instructions (enable universe or add Qt repos). Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app"
# Check and install minimal packages idempotently
PKGS=()
# ensure apt lists
sudo apt-get update -qq
# cmake/ctest
if ! command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKGS+=(cmake); fi
if ! command -v ctest >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKGS+=(cmake); fi
# pkg-config
command -v pkg-config >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKGS+=(pkg-config)
# dev libs
dpkg -s libglib2.0-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKGS+=(libglib2.0-dev)
# Xvfb and xdpyinfo
command -v Xvfb >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKGS+=(xvfb)
command -v xdpyinfo >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKGS+=(x11-utils)
# locales/ca-certificates/binutils only if missing
dpkg -s ca-certificates >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKGS+=(ca-certificates)
locale -a >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKGS+=(locales)
dpkg -s binutils >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKGS+=(binutils)
# Attempt to ensure Qt development packages: prefer libqt6-dev then libqt5-dev
QT_PKG=""
if dpkg -s libqt6-dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then QT_PKG=libqt6-dev; elif dpkg -s libqt5-dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then QT_PKG=libqt5-dev; fi
if [ -z "${QT_PKG}" ]; then
  # Try apt-cache to see availability (not silently ignoring sources)
  if apt-cache show libqt6-dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then QT_PKG=libqt6-dev; elif apt-cache show libqt5-dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then QT_PKG=libqt5-dev; fi
fi
if [ -n "${QT_PKG}" ]; then PKGS+=("${QT_PKG}"); else echo "ERROR: Qt development package (libqt6-dev or libqt5-dev) not found in apt sources. Remediation: enable 'universe' (sudo add-apt-repository universe && sudo apt-get update) or add official Qt repos; aborting." >&2; exit 10; fi
# Install packages if any
if [ ${#PKGS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${PKGS[@]}" >/dev/null || { echo "apt-get install failed for: ${PKGS[*]}" >&2; exit 11; }; fi
# Validate cmake version >= 3.16
if command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then CMV=$(cmake --version | head -n1 | awk '{print $3}'); printf '%s
' "${CMV}" >/tmp/.cmv || true; else echo "cmake not installed" >&2; exit 12; fi
# simple semver compare for minimum 3.16
min_ver="3.16"
ver_compare() { printf '%s
%s
' "$1" "$2" | awk -F. '{printf("%03d%03d%03d\n",$1,$2,$3)}' | sort -n | head -n1; }
if [ "$(ver_compare "$CMV" "$min_ver")" != "$(ver_compare "$min_ver" "$CMV")" ]; then echo "cmake version $CMV < required $min_ver" >&2; exit 13; fi
# Probe pkg-config and Qt layout to compute PKG_CONFIG_PATH and plugin dirs
PKG_PATHS=()
PLUGIN_PATHS=()
# common locations
for p in /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib; do
  [ -d "$p/pkgconfig" ] && PKG_PATHS+=("$p/pkgconfig") || true
  # qt6 and qt5 subdirs
  [ -d "$p/qt6" ] && PKG_PATHS+=("$p/qt6/lib/pkgconfig" "$p/qt6/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pkgconfig") || true
  [ -d "$p/qt5" ] && PKG_PATHS+=("$p/qt5/lib/pkgconfig" "$p/qt5/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pkgconfig") || true
  [ -d "$p/qt6/plugins" ] && PLUGIN_PATHS+=("$p/qt6/plugins") || true
  [ -d "$p/qt5/plugins" ] && PLUGIN_PATHS+=("$p/qt5/plugins") || true
done
# Also use pkg-config to find Qt if available
if command -v pkg-config >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for mod in Qt6Core Qt5Core; do
    if pkg-config --exists "$mod" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      PKG_CONFIG_PRINT_PATH=$(pkg-config --variable pc_path pkg-config 2>/dev/null || true)
      [ -n "$PKG_CONFIG_PRINT_PATH" ] && PKG_PATHS+=("$PKG_CONFIG_PRINT_PATH") || true
      break
    fi
  done
fi
# dedupe
PKG_CONFIG_FINAL=""
for x in "${PKG_PATHS[@]}"; do [[ -n "$x" && ":$PKG_CONFIG_FINAL:" != *":$x:"* ]] && PKG_CONFIG_FINAL="${PKG_CONFIG_FINAL}${x}:"; done
PKG_CONFIG_FINAL="${PKG_CONFIG_FINAL%:}"
PLUGIN_FINAL=""
for x in "${PLUGIN_PATHS[@]}"; do [[ -n "$x" && ":$PLUGIN_FINAL:" != *":$x:"* ]] && PLUGIN_FINAL="${PLUGIN_FINAL}${x}:"; done
PLUGIN_FINAL="${PLUGIN_FINAL%:}"
# Atomically write /etc/profile.d/qt_env.sh
TMPF=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMPF" <<EOF
# Generated by automation: Qt environment helpers
export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
EOF
if [ -n "$PKG_CONFIG_FINAL" ]; then echo "export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=\"$PKG_CONFIG_FINAL:\${PKG_CONFIG_PATH-}\"" >> "$TMPF"; fi
if [ -n "$PLUGIN_FINAL" ]; then echo "export QT_PLUGIN_PATH=\"$PLUGIN_FINAL:\${QT_PLUGIN_PATH-}\"" >> "$TMPF"; fi
# if qt binaries exist, prepend to PATH
if [ -d "/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/qt6/bin" ]; then echo "export PATH=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/qt6/bin:\$PATH" >> "$TMPF"; elif [ -d "/usr/lib/qt6/bin" ]; then echo "export PATH=/usr/lib/qt6/bin:\$PATH" >> "$TMPF"; fi
sudo mv "$TMPF" /etc/profile.d/qt_env.sh && sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/qt_env.sh
# source now
. /etc/profile.d/qt_env.sh || true
# Validate Qt presence via pkg-config or qmake
if command -v pkg-config >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if pkg-config --exists Qt6Core >/dev/null 2>&1; then pkg-config --modversion Qt6Core || true
  elif pkg-config --exists Qt5Core >/dev/null 2>&1; then pkg-config --modversion Qt5Core || true
  else echo "Warning: pkg-config cannot find Qt modules; runtime build may still succeed if qmake is present" >&2
  fi
fi
# Check presence of headless platform plugin (minimal/offscreen/xcb)
FOUND_PLUGIN=0
# look for common platform plugin names
for d in ${PLUGIN_FINAL//:/ }; do
  [ -f "$d/platforms/libqminimal.so" ] && FOUND_PLUGIN=1 && break || true
  [ -f "$d/platforms/libqoffscreen.so" ] && FOUND_PLUGIN=1 && break || true
  [ -f "$d/platforms/libqxcb.so" ] && FOUND_PLUGIN=1 && break || true
done
if [ $FOUND_PLUGIN -eq 0 ]; then echo "Warning: no Qt platform plugin detected in plugin paths; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen may fail at runtime. Install packaging that provides Qt platforms (e.g., libqt6gui6, qt6-wayland, qt6-platform-plugins or similar)" >&2; fi

steps.name: Scaffold minimal CMake-based Qt project (idempotent, short-lived test)
steps.description: Create a minimal idempotent CMake Qt project in the workspace. Produces a main.cpp that starts a QApplication but quits automatically via QTimer::singleShot after 200ms to make tests deterministic. CMakeLists prefers Qt6 then Qt5, sets C++17, disables extensions, and registers a ctest entry using $<TARGET_FILE:...>. Operates in /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app"
mkdir -p "$WS" && cd "$WS"
# If both files exist, skip to preserve any existing project
if [ -f "$WS/CMakeLists.txt" ] && [ -f "$WS/main.cpp" ]; then exit 0; fi
cat > "$WS/main.cpp" <<'CPP'
#include <QApplication>
#include <QLabel>
#include <QTimer>
int main(int argc, char **argv){ QApplication a(argc, argv); QLabel l("Qt Headless Test"); l.show(); // quit shortly to make test deterministic
 QTimer::singleShot(200, &a, &QCoreApplication::quit); return a.exec(); }
CPP
cat > "$WS/CMakeLists.txt" <<'CMAKE'
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(elegant_clock LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
find_package(Qt6 COMPONENTS Widgets QUIET)
if (TARGET Qt6::Widgets)
  set(USE_QT6 TRUE)
endif()
if (NOT USE_QT6)
  find_package(Qt5 COMPONENTS Widgets QUIET)
  if (TARGET Qt5::Widgets)
    set(USE_QT5 TRUE)
  endif()
endif()
add_executable(elegant_clock main.cpp)
if (USE_QT6)
  target_link_libraries(elegant_clock PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets)
elseif (USE_QT5)
  target_link_libraries(elegant_clock PRIVATE Qt5::Widgets)
else()
  message(WARNING "No Qt target found; configure may fail without Qt dev installed")
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME run_headless_app COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:elegant_clock>)
CMAKE
mkdir -p build

steps.name: Configure headless test runner, build, and run ctest (with timeout)
steps.description: Start Xvfb when needed, ensure DISPLAY or QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen is set, run a deterministic CMake configure/build in workspace/build, and execute ctest with a per-test timeout to avoid hangs. Cleans up Xvfb after run. Operates in /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app"
cd "$WS"
XVFB_PID=""
if ! pgrep -f "Xvfb :99" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 &
  XVFB_PID=$!
  trap 'if [ -n "${XVFB_PID}" ]; then kill ${XVFB_PID} 2>/dev/null || true; fi' EXIT
  for i in {1..10}; do sleep 0.5; xdpyinfo -display :99 >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || true; done
  xdpyinfo -display :99 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Xvfb failed to start" >&2; exit 20; }
else
  XVFB_PID=$(pgrep -f "Xvfb :99" | head -n1)
fi
export DISPLAY=:99
. /etc/profile.d/qt_env.sh 2>/dev/null || true
# Configure and build
mkdir -p build
cmake -S . -B build -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null || { echo "cmake configure failed" >&2; exit 21; }
JOBS=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2)
cmake --build build -- -j"$JOBS" >/dev/null || { echo "build failed" >&2; exit 22; }
# Run ctest with per-test timeout (seconds) to avoid hangs
CTEST_TIMEOUT=5
ctest --output-on-failure -C Release --timeout $CTEST_TIMEOUT || { echo "ctest failed" >&2; exit 23; }

steps.description: Build the project if needed, start the built binary under a short timeout/watchdog using Xvfb or QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen fallback, verify process started, capture stdout/stderr, stop the process gracefully, and report exit status. Operates in /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/elegant-clock-223339-223348/qt_clock_native_app"
cd "$WS"
XVFB_PID=""
USE_OFFSCREEN=0
if ! pgrep -f "Xvfb :99" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 >/tmp/xvfb_val.log 2>&1 &
  XVFB_PID=$!
  trap 'if [ -n "${XVFB_PID}" ]; then kill ${XVFB_PID} 2>/dev/null || true; fi' EXIT
  for i in {1..10}; do sleep 0.5; xdpyinfo -display :99 >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || true; done
  xdpyinfo -display :99 >/dev/null 2>&1 || USE_OFFSCREEN=1
else
  XVFB_PID=$(pgrep -f "Xvfb :99" | head -n1)
fi
if [ "$USE_OFFSCREEN" -eq 0 ]; then export DISPLAY=:99; else export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen; fi
. /etc/profile.d/qt_env.sh 2>/dev/null || true
# Build (idempotent)
mkdir -p build
cmake -S . -B build -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null || { echo "cmake configure failed" >&2; exit 30; }
JOBS=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2)
cmake --build build -- -j"$JOBS" >/dev/null || { echo "build failed" >&2; exit 31; }
BIN="$WS/build/elegant_clock"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || { echo "build binary missing: $BIN" >&2; exit 32; }
# Run with timeout to avoid indefinite hang (5s)
TMP_OUT=/tmp/elegant_clock.out
TMP_ERR=/tmp/elegant_clock.err
timeout 5s "$BIN" >"$TMP_OUT" 2>"$TMP_ERR" &
APP_PID=$!
sleep 0.5
if ! ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "app failed to start" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$TMP_ERR" || true; exit 33; fi
ps -p "$APP_PID" -o pid,cmd
# Attempt graceful shutdown
kill "$APP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
set +e
wait "$APP_PID"
WAIT_RET=$?
set -e
echo "app exit status: $WAIT_RET"
echo "--- STDOUT ---"; sed -n '1,200p' "$TMP_OUT" || true
echo "--- STDERR ---"; sed -n '1,200p' "$TMP_ERR" || true
if [ -n "${XVFB_PID}" ]; then kill ${XVFB_PID} 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [ "$WAIT_RET" -eq 0 ]; then echo "validation: OK"; else echo "validation: FAILED with exit $WAIT_RET" >&2; exit 40; fi

Scripts follow required shebang, set -euo pipefail, use the authoritative workspace path, and persist environment via /etc/profile.d/*.sh. Each step is concise and idempotent and includes validation checks.
